_comment: Reuses github.token. token / token_env here override that, then fall back to github, then $GITHUB_TOKEN. Empty accounts discovers the viewer login and every org they belong to. Empty repos means recently-pushed repos that have workflow files, capped at max_repos per owner so one busy org cannot hide personal — never every repo the token can see. The screen names the cap.
_token_comment: Optional GitHub token override for this widget; empty reuses github.token.
_token_env_comment: Optional environment-variable override; empty reuses the shared GitHub token source.
_accounts_comment: GitHub users or organizations to inspect; empty discovers the viewer and their organizations.
_repos_comment: Explicit owner/repository names; empty discovers recently pushed repositories with workflows.
_window_hours_comment: Hours of workflow runs included in summaries.
_max_repos_comment: Maximum discovered repositories inspected per account.
_pushed_days_comment: How recently a repository must have been pushed to qualify for discovery.
